ei.title: Imagine you have the best tea in the world and you
ei.subject: 6월 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Imagine you have the best tea in the world and you

fullPassage: Imagine you have the best tea in the world and you put it into a bag that's impermeable. It won't work. You just won't be able to make a cup of tea. For the teabag to work, it needs to be porous. You need the tea and the water to come in contact with each other. In our lives too, we cannot survive and thrive in isolation. Leaders need to be careful not to build walls around themselves that prevent people from reaching out to them. As a leader, you need to be able to touch other people. The tea was meant to mix with the water. Similarly, all of us were designed to work with other people, with teams, and with society at large.

questions.passage: Imagine you have the best tea in the world and you put it into a bag that's ①<u>impermeable</u>. It won't work. You just won't be able to make a cup of tea. For the teabag to work, it needs to be ②<u>porous</u>. You need the tea and the water ③<u>coming</u> in contact with each other. In our lives too, we cannot survive and thrive in ④<u>isolation</u>. Leaders need to be careful not to build walls around themselves that prevent people from reaching out to them. As a leader, you need to be able to touch other people. The tea was meant to mix with the water. Similarly, all of us were designed to work with other people, with teams, and with society at large.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: coming → to come: need + O + to V 구문에서 동명사는 오류
det.analysis:
❌ ① impermeable — 형용사. 'a bag that's impermeable'에서 보어로 올바름
❌ ② porous — 형용사 보어. 'it needs to be porous'는 be + 형용사로 올바름
✅ ③ coming — 원문은 to come. 'You need the tea and the water to come in contact'에서 need + O + to V가 올바른 구문. coming은 틀림 ←정답
❌ ④ isolation — 명사. 'in isolation'은 전치사 + 명사로 올바름
det.tip: need + O + to V (목적격 보어로 to부정사)

questions.passage: Imagine you have the best tea in the world and you put it into a bag that's impermeable. It won't work. You just won't be able to make a cup of tea. For the teabag to work, it needs to be porous. You need the tea and the water to come in contact with each other. In our lives too, we cannot survive and thrive in isolation. Leaders need to be careful not to build walls around ①<u>them</u> that prevent people from ②<u>reaching</u> out to them. As a leader, you need to be able to touch other people. The tea was ③<u>meant</u> to mix with the water. Similarly, all of us were ④<u>designed</u> to work with other people, with teams, and with society at large.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: them → themselves: 주어=목적어이면 재귀대명사 필수
det.analysis:
✅ ① them — 원문은 themselves. 'build walls around themselves'에서 주어 Leaders가 자기 주위에 벽을 쌓으므로 재귀대명사 필요. them은 틀림 ←정답
❌ ② reaching — 동명사. 'from reaching out'에서 전치사 from 뒤 동명사로 올바름
❌ ③ meant — 과거분사. 'was meant to mix'에서 수동태로 올바름
❌ ④ designed — 과거분사. 'were designed to work'에서 수동태로 올바름
det.tip: 주어 = 목적어 → 재귀대명사 (themselves, not them)

questions.passage: Imagine you have the ①<u>best</u> tea in the world and you put it into a bag ④<u>what</u>'s impermeable. It ②<u>won't</u> work. You just won't be able to make a cup of tea. For the teabag to work, it needs to be porous. You need the tea and the water to come in contact with each other. In our lives too, we cannot survive and thrive in isolation. Leaders need to be ③<u>careful</u> not to build walls around themselves that prevent people from reaching out to them. As a leader, you need to be able to touch other people. The tea was meant to mix with the water. Similarly, all of us were designed to work with other people, with teams, and with society at large.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: what → that: 선행사 walls가 있으므로 관계대명사 that 필요
det.analysis:
❌ ① best — 최상급. 'the best tea'에서 정관사+최상급으로 올바름
❌ ② won't — 미래 부정. 'It won't work'에서 올바름
❌ ③ careful — 형용사 보어. 'be careful'에서 올바름
✅ ④ what — 원문은 that. 'walls that prevent people'에서 walls(선행사) 뒤 관계대명사 that 필요. what은 선행사 포함이므로 앞에 walls가 있으면 틀림 ←정답
det.tip: 선행사 있음 → that/which. what = the thing that(선행사 포함)

Leaders need to be careful not to build walls around themselves that prevent people from reaching out to them. As a leader, you need to be able to touch other people. The tea was meant to mix with the water. ③<u>Similarly</u>, all of us were designed to work with other people, with teams, and with society ④<u>at large</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: be able to → be able (X): to 생략 시 touch가 연결 불가
det.analysis:
❌ ① it — 대명사. 'put it into a bag'에서 tea를 받는 목적격 대명사로 올바름
✅ ② be able — 원문은 be able to. 'you need to be able to touch'에서 to 생략 시 문법 오류 ←정답
❌ ③ Similarly — 부사. 문두 전환 부사로 올바름
❌ ④ at large — 숙어. 'society at large'는 '사회 전체'로 올바름
det.tip: be able to + V원형. to 생략 불가

det.korean: 고립 속에서 번성(thrive)할 수 없다. decline(쇠퇴)은 반대 의미
det.analysis:
❌ ① porous — 원문 일치. 티백이 다공성이어야 한다
❌ ② contact — 원문 일치. 차와 물이 접촉해야 한다
✅ ③ decline — 원문은 thrive. 'cannot survive and decline'은 '생존도 쇠퇴도 못한다'로 논리 모순 ←정답
❌ ④ walls — 원문 일치. 벽을 쌓지 말라
det.tip: thrive(번성) ↔ decline(쇠퇴)

det.korean: 함께 일하도록 설계(designed)되었다. forbidden(금지된)은 정반대

✅ ④ forbidden — 원문은 designed. '함께 일하도록 금지되었다'는 정반대 ←정답

❌ ③ work with other people: 본문에 등장하지만 'cannot work with other people in isolation'은 문맥 부적절
❌ ④ come in contact: 본문에 등장하지만 'cannot come in contact in isolation'은 문법적 부자연스러움
